description: Parity: in the Launch at login row the status text (Enabled) is the same text size as the Launch at login label, not larger.
requirement: P2-settings-login-text (GPUI Phase 2b parity, Tauri ee80e70:dist/panel.css .set-pill/.set-sub at --fs-meta)
notes: The Tauri settings view had no launch-at-login row; its nearest equivalents, the status pill (.set-pill) and the row's sub line (.set-sub), used --fs-meta (12 px). The GPUI row uses font_size::META for both texts.
Sizes are measured, not declared: view.layout.login_label.font_px and view.layout.login_status.font_px are the text sizes GPUI resolves for each text's element at prepaint (views/layout.rs).
Must fail on the instrumentation commit (before the fix) at 'Enabled is the label's size' (14 vs 11.375 px).
